model_limits: No manufacturer page survives for the 2 W LaserCube; every figure is a reseller copy. Nothing has been checked against a physical unit, and this is a Class 4 laser that the inventory says only runs with a technician.

category_limits.Connections: Connector type and function follow the manufacturer document; exact placement in this reconstruction is approximate.
category_limits.Controls: Control function follows the manufacturer document; knob and button placement is approximate.

sources.label: X-Laser / Wicked Lasers LaserCube 2W (LC-1000) reseller listing
sources.scope: Model LC-1000, Class 4, 2 W (blue 450 nm 1200 mW, green 520 nm 400 mW, red 638 nm 400 mW), 4.0 mm / 1.0 mrad beam, 4 × 4 × 4.4 in (10 × 10 × 11 cm), 3.7 lb (1.7 kg), 14,000 mAh battery for about 3 h, micro USB control, remote interlock connector, DC input, key control. Not a manufacturer page; xlaser.com no longer lists the 2W.

sources.label: NNC gear record
sources.scope: Unit identity, quantity, and retailer-reproduced figures where the manufacturer page no longer carries them.

sources.label: NNC equipment inventory
sources.scope: Which units NNC owns and how many.

components.label: Cube body
components.purpose: About 10 × 10 × 11 cm and 1.7 kg, Class 4, 2 W total output from blue, green and red diodes, with a 14,000 mAh battery good for roughly three hours.
components.limits: Reseller figures; the exact 2 W envelope is unconfirmed.

components.label: Output aperture
components.purpose: Beam exit, 4.0 mm at 1.0 mrad. Beams stay above the crowd unless a variance says otherwise; the NNC laser technician is required.

components.label: Key switch
components.purpose: Key control is required to re-arm after a power loss or interlock cycle.

components.label: Micro USB control port
components.purpose: Control from a PC, Mac or Android device over micro USB; emission stops if the cable is disconnected.
components.limits: Later WiFi and Ultra models use USB-C or Ethernet instead.

components.label: Remote interlock connector
components.purpose: Safety shut-off socket for the emergency-stop box; opening the loop terminates emission.

components.label: DC power input
components.purpose: DC input for the mains adapter that runs the unit and charges the battery.

evidence_policy.physical_verification: None; no dimension or placement has been checked against a physical unit
